create_chat: create a new chat session for a user with title, chat data, and optional folder ID
import_chats: import multiple chat sessions into the database for a user with metadata and timestamps
search_chats: search chats by text, tags, folders, pinned status, and shared status with pagination
update_chat_message: insert or update a message in a chat history by chat ID and message ID
delete_chat: delete a chat session by ID and remove its associated shared chat copy
